headline: Approved $50,000 to repower the BHD 27' patrol boat, 6-0.
summary: The Harbor Management Authority discussed repowering the BHD 27' patrol boat to make it operational again. Peter Dickman explained that repowering means replacing the engines, and the boat is currently out of commission. The authority approved funding $50,000 for this work, with an understood commitment from the mayor to request that the City Council reimburse half the cost.
decisions: Approved $50,000 to repower the BHD 27' patrol boat, with HMA funding 100% of the cost and an understood commitment that the mayor will request a 50% transfer for reimbursement upon City Council approval, 6-0.
